scope: Production one-shot SFX planning only. Background music, continuous ambience, and voice acting are outside this milestone.

rules.canonical_entity_ids: Match exact runtime IDs. Enemy IDs E01 through E15 are uppercase in this field only. Use lowercase snake_case for cue IDs and audio filenames.
rules.filename_root: Repository relative. Runtime integration may prepend res://.
rules.required_and_optional: Required means first delivery of its base asset. Optional assets and variants are deferred first if memory, clarity or schedule demands it.
rules.variant_dispatch: Dispatch to the base cue or variant_group, normally variant_index 1. Other cue IDs name alternate files for that same logical event. Avoid immediate repeats, use presentation-only selection and keep RNG separate from gameplay.

hook_status.live_audio: This source already reaches audio through a generic cue. The proposed semantic split can still require a later routing change.
hook_status.existing_signal_unbound: The indicated runtime event exists and has no dedicated sound route for this event.
hook_status.required_presentation_hook: A presentation edge, result delta, useful payload or new routing decision is required. No runtime hook added by this milestone.

rules.fallback: Direct cue ID, current legacy cue ID, or null for deliberate silence. Prefer the most specific compatible cue, at most one foreground cue per logical gameplay action. Follow fallbacks to the original procedural player for existing IDs. Resolve a legacy ID directly to its procedural leaf when its replacement is absent, avoiding recursion.
rules.time_units: Durations in milliseconds; retrigger is foreground monotonic audio wall time. Trigger evidence comes from existing gameplay state and the shared CombatClock, never from sound or rendered frame counts.
rules.priority: Higher integer wins. Proposed 0–100 scale, with generic UI under 45, routine attacks under 55, tactical warnings around 70–96, and terminal receipts highest once revealed.
rules.polyphony: Limit is concurrent voices per variant group, including all variants. Later mixer cap of 8 SFX voices on Android and 12 on Windows is an initial trial, with at least 2 reserved for warnings and receipts within that cap.
rules.gain: Initial relative cue trim in dB, composed with saved Master and SFX. No gain changes applied in C36-A.
rules.metadata: Production status planned. Null measured_audio_properties and provenance until actual asset validation and rights receipt. An empty CSV cell is JSON null.

batches.A: UI, progression, education, restoration and results.
batches.B: One-shot battle, Ranger, Facility, enemy and boss feedback.

storage_budget.method: Estimated by rounding upwards to whole frames at 22050 mono signed PCM16 frames/second, plus a 44-byte nominal WAV header per file. No import or APK compression assumed.
